{"command": "str_replace", "path": "/memories/repo/scaffold-dev-live-preview.md", "old_str": "9. **Known unrelated follow-on bug, not fixed**: once css/components/tinymce all install correctly,
   Vite's dep-prebundle step fails on `@pantoken/plugin-simple-icons` (a transitive dep of the
   published `@pantoken/tinymce`) — `"./manifest.json" is not exported under the conditions [...]
   from package .../plugin-simple-icons/package.json`. That package isn't part of this repo (external
   published dep resolved from the registry) — its own `exports` map needs a `./manifest.json` entry
   under the `import`/`browser` conditions. Out of scope for scaffold-dev.ts; a separate published-
   package bug.", "new_str": "9. **FIXED (was misdiagnosed as external).** `@pantoken/tinymce` was a direct scaffold dep but wasn't
   in `PACKAGE_DIRS`, so it installed the *published* npm version instead of being linked to local
   source. Its transitive dep `@pantoken/plugin-simple-icons` IS a monorepo package
   (`plugins/pantoken/simple-icons`) whose local `exports` map already has `./manifest.json`, but the
   currently-published npm version (0.3.6) lacks that export entry (stale) — Vite's dep-pre-bundle
   then fails: `"./manifest.json" is not exported under the conditions [...]`. Fix: add
   `"@pantoken/tinymce": "renderers/tinymce"` to `PACKAGE_DIRS` in `scaffold-dev.ts` so it gets `vp
   link`ed like the other deps — its own resolution of `@pantoken/plugin-simple-icons` then walks up
   to the real monorepo's workspace-linked (up-to-date) copy instead of the stale registry install.
   Lesson: before calling a resolution failure "an external package's bug," check whether the
   package is actually a workspace package in this repo (`grep` its name across `*/package.json`) —
   `plugin-simple-icons` looked like a random npm dep name but is `plugins/pantoken/simple-icons`."}
